method: One resident model per precision. Each request is called twice in uncached, cached, and reverse cached order; first calls include plan preparation, repeats reuse the last graph. Cached mode is cleared between phases. All resident times include encoding, preparation, inference and readback; model loading is excluded. Shared GPU, one timing sample per call; not a full-suite accuracy or throughput claim.
